page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-96-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 756.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with 8 local NVMe SSDs, though the exact total capacity is not specified in the hardware profile. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

This instance provides a high-density memory configuration alongside dedicated compute resources, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require consistent CPU performance. The inclusion of 8 local NVMe SSDs provides low-latency local storage capabilities. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-core ratio and bundled local NVMe storage offer a consolidated resource profile, reducing the need for external storage attachments for high-throughput operations.

The resource balance of the c4d-highmem-96-lssd makes it appropriate for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines. The combination of 96 dedicated vCPUs and 756.0 GB of RAM supports heavy multi-threaded execution and large working datasets.
